fixed_domain_matrix.realization: All fixed color, border, elevation, opacity, motion, radius and layer values are realized as candidate CSS custom properties or exact rules.
Exact Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui stack; RU/EN stress is separately captured.
32 px compact controls, profile area and minimum analytical rows are retained with zero tolerance.
The rail/workspace gap is exactly 12 px and the inner rhythm follows the fixed 8 px token.
Compact icon rail plus contextual overlay preserves fixed identity and deterministic keyboard/dismissal behavior for the representative screen.
Primary rail, header and independently scrolling fluid workspace are bound by the representative contract.

Grouped icon-control surfaces, simultaneously visible chart and dense table, Result Trust, full-height inspector and external series panel realize the accepted analytical grammar without copying pilot fixtures.
The fixed 768–1920 Web range keeps the inspector as a full-height sibling on wide Web, transforms it to a contained overlay below 1200 px, moves series to a lower panel, and introduces no mobile IA.
